scope.goal: Remove the repository-held shared ESP registration credential and use a Firebase Functions Secret Manager parameter with a firmware build-time input.

security_invariants.rule: No shared ESP registration credential may be committed to the PWA repository.
The Functions endpoint must fail closed when its Secret Manager value is unavailable.
No secret value may be retrieved, printed, committed, or supplied by the agent.

human_owned_steps: Set a new ESP_AUTH_TOKEN Secret Manager value immediately before an approved Function deployment.
Provide the same value only to the authorized firmware build environment and reflash affected devices.
Retire the old value after verified migration.
